title: Challenge, credential and receipt anatomy
caption: What each of the three messages carries. The challenge id binds every parameter except description, the credential echoes the challenge, and the receipt appears only on success.
alt: Three stacked boxes. Challenge in WWW-Authenticate: Payment with status 402: required id, realm, method, intent and request; optional digest, expires, description, header and opaque; id computed as HMAC-SHA256 over the parameters joined by pipes. Credential in Authorization: Payment as base64url: challenge echo, optional payer DID source, method payload, sent in Payment-Authorization when the challenge set header. Receipt in Payment-Receipt, 2xx only: status success, method, timestamp and reference, with method extras such as subscriptionId, challengeId and channelId.
